title: Gorard and Wolfram hypergraph physics project recovers GR and quantum mechanics

tellings.quote: and so that is that was like his breakthrough result in 2020 2021 and And that was like really suggestive, right?

plain: Matthew Pines, an analyst speaking on a podcast, says that the physicist Jonathan Gorard, working with the scientist Stephen Wolfram and a researcher named Xerxes Arsiwalla, reached a breakthrough in 2020 and 2021. According to Pines, their project, which pictures the universe as a vast web of connected points called a hypergraph and grows out of Wolfram's book A New Kind of Science, recovered both general relativity, Einstein's theory of gravity, and quantum mechanics, the physics of the very small. He calls the result really suggestive, since it would hint that both theories come from one simpler foundation.
